author: Unreal Engine
description:
Take a look at Substrate, Unreal Engine’s state-of-the-art modular material authoring and rendering framework that offers inherent support for layered and blended materials, enabling you to render high-quality materials with true physical accuracy. 

Now Production-Ready and enabled by default in Unreal Engine 5.7, Substrate introduces a new approach to material rendering and data storage, giving you greater flexibility and control over how materials are built and evaluated.

Find out more about what’s new in Unreal Engine 5.7 and download today: https://www.unrealengine.com/en-US/news/unreal-engine-5-7-is-now-available
